iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

htonl
       Converts the unsigned integer from host byte order to network byte order.

SYNOPSIS
       htonl NUMBER

DESCRIPTION
       Convert the unsigned integer from host byte order to network byte order.

       Syntax

       htonl 

	    * Convert the unsigned integer from host byte order to network byte
	      order.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       GLOBAL_GTM

EXAMPLES
	when HTTP_REQUEST {
	  set hostlong 12345678
	  set netlong [htonl $hostlong]
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.2 --First introduced the command.
